title.tr: Ahşap kaplı cephede panolu ceviz tonlu çift kanatlı kapı
title.en: Panelled walnut-toned double door on a timber-clad facade

alt.tr: Ahşap kaplı cephede buzlu camlı, panolu, koyu bal rengi cilalı çift kanatlı ahşap kapı, yanda elektrik sayacı
alt.en: Polished dark-honey panelled double timber door with frosted glazing at the top

caption.tr: Kapı pano ve cam bölümleriyle simetrik. Cephedeki yatay kaplama kapının rengiyle uyumlu.
caption.en: The door is symmetrical with its panels and glazing. The horizontal cladding on the facade matches its colour.
